user.title: ICA
user.description: Log in on www.ica.se in a desktop browser, open developer tools (F12) → Application/Storage → Cookies → https://www.ica.se and copy the value of thSessionId.

reauth_confirm.title: ICA session expired
reauth_confirm.description: Your ICA login has expired. Log in on www.ica.se again and paste the new thSessionId cookie.

error.invalid_auth: The cookie is not valid or not logged in.

abort.already_configured: This ICA account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: That cookie belongs to a different ICA account.
